ranked.text: The primary weather vendor (service:gridcast:weather-vendor-wx-primary) returned HTTP 503/5xx responses to ingestion during the incident window, causing weather-observation batch failures.
The failure is specific to the weather-observation path; demand ingestion remained healthy.
The primary weather vendor payloads violated ingestion's expected contract, causing weather-observation batch failures independently of transport 5xx responses.
The primary weather vendor served repeated or stale values, triggering downstream weather-variability warnings.
